description: This file defines the ChainedBlockStream class, which implements a PHP stream wrapper for reading data from an OLE compound document structure, specifically handling chained blocks within the OLE container.

classes.name: ChainedBlockStream
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper class for reading chained blocks from an OLE container.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Initializes the stream by parsing the resource URL, locating the correct block data, and loading it into memory.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream and cleans up resources.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Moves the file pointer to a specified position based on offset and whence.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns information about the stream, currently only the size.
